svg.aria-label: LIMBO — Two phones fog silver offline; reconnected, the fog lifts and a cyanotype ghost tent waits for one tap. Animated: two replica cards lose their link and fog over while Sari ticks the tent and Budi deletes it; the link returns, the edits cross, the tent comes back as a ghost twin under rule resurrect, one tap keeps it, and an oxblood FIXED stamp lands and settles as both lists match. Measured: 3 replicas × 10,000 orderings, 0 failures.
